column3: “My own flesh and blood” replaces my kinsmen according to the flesh.
“The people of Israel” replaces Israelites; “divine” and “temple” are supplied.
“Human descent” renders according to the flesh; “worthy of praise” renders blessed.
“The appointed time” replaces this time; “return” replaces come.
“Children” is supplied as the subject where Rebecca is the grammatical subject.
Is God unjust recasts is there injustice with God.
“Does ... depend” supplies a verb; “effort” replaces running.
“One of you” replaces you; “God” specifies He; “can resist” replaces has resisted.
“For special occasions” and “for common use” replace unto honor and unto dishonor.
“What if He did this” is supplied; “His” is supplied with mercy.
“Thoroughly and decisively” renders completing and cutting short.
